ios.desc:
Whether it's forgetful roommates or a messy family we'll help you get your household in order. Schedule, organize, and keep track of chores and expenses.

You can finally breathe that sigh of relief, here’s an app that was created by people who have faced the very same problem you’re dealing with now. WeDivvy is the perfect app for organizing that never ending to-do list, reminding your forgetful home members, helping everyone stay on the same page, and so much more. All you have to do to get started is add your tasks, add your home members, and let WeDivvy take care of the rest while you sit back and forget what a stressful life used to feel like.



■ Quick and Easy Setup
- We know you’ve got things to do and trying out a new app can be a headache. That’s why we’ve made sure our sign-up process takes no longer than 2 minutes. On top of that, we offer dozens of suggested tasks to start with, plus the ability to add multiple tasks at a time.

■ Organizational Tools
- Whether you prefer things ready-to-go or you prefer to do things your way we have a bunch of built-in as well as customizable tools for you to organize your home including folders, lists, and tags.

■ Multiple Options For Sorting and Prioritizing
- Goes without saying that not all tasks are created equal. Remembering to pick up toilet paper is a heck of a lot more important than making your bed. For this, we’ve added a bunch of tools to let you prioritize what needs to get done above all else. You can color code your tasks, add tags, or even add a priority level.

■ Wide Range of Scheduling Options
- This is our bread and butter, what makes us the best of the best. We can accommodate just about any type of chore or expense you have in mind. Create chores & expenses that repeat daily, weekly, monthly, take turns, repeat whenever needed, and much more.

■ Flexibility For Irregular Chores & Expenses
- We know life can be hectic and things can change unexpectedly. That’s why we made tasks flexible and easy to change at the drop of a hat. Someone can’t do their chores today? Skip their turn. Does a chore not need to be done this week? Put in on pause. Does someone owe a little more on an expense this month? Update their amount owed. Whatever it is, it’s only a few taps away.
